name: Confidentiality — Trade-Secret Grade
text: The Employee acknowledges that, in the course of employment, they will have access to trade secrets and highly sensitive proprietary information of the Employer, including source code, algorithms, formulae, processes, designs, customer and pricing data, and business strategies (collectively, "Trade-Secret Information"). The Employee shall: (a) hold all Trade-Secret Information in strict confidence and use it solely for the performance of their duties; (b) not copy, remove, transmit, or store such information except on the Employer's authorised and secured systems; (c) not reverse engineer or derive the underlying know-how; and (d) not, during or after employment, use or disclose any Trade-Secret Information for their own benefit or that of any third party. These obligations are in addition to, and survive termination of, this Agreement for so long as the information retains the character of a trade secret and is not lawfully in the public domain.

legal_basis.note: Confidentiality operating during employment is valid; post-employment use restrictions protecting trade secrets are enforceable
Reasonable security practices for sensitive information

invalid_if: Information is lawfully in the public domain
